normalized.description: A ground-based microwave radiometer system with dual-polarized receivers (vertical & horizontal polarizations) operating at 36.5 and 18.7 GHz for satellite cal/val activities. See also the optional modules in the annex 1. The system should have a modular design allowing measurement with and without a positioner using flexible receiver module (frequency) combinations. The bidder may select a positioner system capable of azimuth/elevation turning and design the radiometer system to fit the chosen positioner. Including the positioner itself in the tender is optional, but a significant part of the quality comparison. The system should enable both autonomous and campaign-type operation via a remotely or locally operated connection. The system should enable automated storage and preprocessing of observations and operation of azimuth/elevation positioner according to predefined scheduler. The design must enable continuous operation using mains power. The radiometer must be operable in Arctic environmental conditions, providing system stability according to specified requirements.

Der Auftragnehmer haftet für die sichere Aufbewahrung der Sicherungskarten. Für die im Rahmen des Vertrages beschäftigten Arbeitskräfte ist ein polizeiliches Führungszeugnis vorzulegen, das nicht älter als 6 Monate ist. Die Angaben sind innerhalb von 4 Wochen nach Beauftragung dem Auftraggeber zu übergeben. Die Daten werden gespeichert. Die Überprüfung ist für den Auftraggeber kostenfrei und soll 20 Werktage nach Beauftragung abgeschlossen sein. The objective of this contract is to ensure input from and the participation of environmental NGOS, consumer NGOs and organizations representing SMEs into relevant existing & any future expert groups and any other aspects related to the Environmental Footprint (EF) methods (see below). 

The Environmental Footprint (EF ) Steering Committee and the Technical Advisory Board Expert Groups. The first group includes representatives of the European Commission, Member States, main stakeholder groups (environmental NGOs, consumers and SMEs) and economic sectors. The second group includes environmental footprint and life cycle assessment experts. In these expert groups other EF related aspects such as methodological choices of the EF methods or specific modelling requirements of the datasets are discussed. 
For supporting the potential implementation of the Green Claims Directive, the Commission may create a new expert group. The representation of the SMEs and environmental and consumer NGOs is crucial to ensure that its implementation is balanced and inclusive.
